desc: Demonstrating the modularity of the FN 509 platform, the FN 509 CC Edge XL combines the best of the FN 509 Edge series for a high-performance pistol designed for speed, accuracy and control. Featuring the CC Edge slide with quick-detach compensator designed to reduce muzzle rise up to 25-percent and the full-sized LS Edge frame with improved texturing for secure grip, the FN 509 CC Edge XL delivers an extremely flat shooting experience with significant recoil reduction for faster sight picture recovery, improving speed to target, accuracy, and overall control of the pistol.
